summary: The repeated-trial receipt settled the exposure question across phases and forced one honest correction. Comparison 0 held over all twelve interrupted trials — each admitted by its own baseline, none missing — with the last successful confirmation between 44ms and 49ms after the partition and the detached voters' leader first appearing between 67ms and 142ms, so the separation was reproduced in twelve of twelve phases with margins from 18ms to 98ms, and the leader stepped down in every trial. The consequence question is therefore refuted for this configuration family with breadth behind it: the confirmation window closes before a competing leader can exist, and the reason is the enforced relation LeaderLeaseTimeout <= HeartbeatTimeout <= ElectionTimeout rather than the particular numbers. Comparison 1 came back violated, and I recorded that plainly instead of absorbing it: each control obtained exactly one confirmation at elapsed 0ms, which is the in-flight window — the controls cut the leader off from every peer including the nonvoter, an in-memory RPC already handed to a peer completes through its response channel even after the route is removed, and my harness polled immediately after applying the partition — so the control assertion was mis-scoped for this setup and does not carry the 'no confirmation without the nonvoter' reading; the record cannot attribute that acknowledgement to a peer, so the explanation is consistent with the timing rather than demonstrated. I revised the parent VerifyLeader account on the same basis: the mechanism stays asserted, now corroborated by eight to ten consecutive confirmations per trial over roughly 45ms with the tally at 2 against a quorum of 2 while only the nonvoter was reachable — traffic in flight to the voters cannot explain that, since those routes stayed removed for the whole window — while the earlier stale-read reading is corrected rather than repeated. Both questions are marked explained, so the record now shows two execution-grounded findings, two refuted suspicions, and the narrowings that limit each one.
